answer: A comet enters dune only by burning atlas equal to the total atlas already burned there, and that total updates on every anchor, so simultaneous anchors collide: the loser must re-read and burn the higher sum. The nth comet therefore burns more than the sum of all before it, and a thousand clones cannot batch, shard, or queue around one total. The bill is atlas burned per anchor, attached to each registration. It fails if registrations can be batched against a stale total or dune forked.
